notes.title: Update 1.1.5
notes.notes:
What’s New in Update 1.1.5?

 Updated the visual of the Slot Machine Token.
 Updated the visual of the Wedding Ring.
 Adjusted the Clock’s time display.
 Fixed a bug that prevented running in certain sections of the game.
 Fixed a bug that caused the bookcase to not display correctly.
 Improved overall game stability.

Warning
This is a major game update. If you had an ongoing game, your saves are not compatible. If you don’t want to restart from the beginning, go to the game properties on Steam, select "Beta", and choose "Old Version" from the dropdown menu. This will restore the previous version of the game where your saves still work.


Thanks to you, the journey continues!
Doesn't Matter Games Studio

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
What’s new in Update 1.0.5?

 Removed the "Examine" button from notes.
 Increased the range of the "Examine icon" for Crazy Joe’s hat.
 Made the game’s beginning easier.
 Clarified the mechanism of the daguerreotype.
 Removed save overwriting and added multiple save slots.
 Added new notes to the journal.
 Added explanations about the Sanity System and drunkenness.
 Removed the ability to get drunk at the beginning of the game.
 Added explanations on how the bookshelf puzzle works.
 Added this "Updates" section that you are reading.
 Added a new Achievement.

Warning
This is a major game update. If you had an ongoing game, your saves are not compatible.
